thread:
ella_support: FYI a customer on eu-west1 is seeing p95 embed latency jump from ~120ms -> 700ms since last night. reported via support ticket 8764.

infra_bot: Alert: embeddings-service-eu-west1 p95 > 600ms for 5m (route: /v1/embeddings, model: rdl-small-embed)

jason_oncall: Looking. Any recent infra changes in eu-west1?

ella_support: Customer says they saw it after the maintenance window (kernel + cuda driver push) around 02:00 UTC. They also mentioned intermittent API 503s during the spike.

anya_infra: I'm pulling metrics. iostat and nvme stats look noisy on host pool-az3-nvme-04. Queue depth spiking to 128 intermittently, avg await up to 45ms.

leo_sre: Can you paste iostat snapshot?

anya_infra: ```
Device             r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  await
nvme0n1          120.0   300.5  10240.0 24576.0  38.5
nvme1n1           40.1    12.3   2048.0  1024.0  12.2
```

maria_dev: That aligns with higher request latency. Embeddings workload is IO-sensitive at model load time and for KV cache writes. If host IO stalls, p95 jumps.

jason_oncall: Is this a single-host issue or fleet?

anya_infra: Spike concentrated on pool-az3-nvme-04 and pool-az3-nvme-05. Other azs normal. Both hosts had kernel 6.2.15+cuda12.2 pushed in the window.

leo_sre: Possible host-kernel NVMe scheduling regression + thin-provisioned storage GC causing IO storms. Anyone repro with fio?

anya_infra: Running quick fio: ```
fio --name=randread --ioengine=libaio --bs=4k --rw=randread --numjobs=8 --size=1G --time_based --runtime=60
... 4k rand read iops drop under heavy qdepth ...
```

maria_dev: Mitigations: 1) Route eu-west1 embeddings traffic to warm standby pool (az1) via smart routing for the next 30m. 2) Temporarily disable KV cache writes on affected hosts (sacrifice cold-start perf). 3) Roll back host kernel on pool-az3 hosts to previous kernel.

jason_oncall: I'll trigger routing change and KV cache toggle now. @tim_product can we notify the impacted customer with ETA ~60m?

tim_product: I'll draft an update. Will mention we're mitigating and investigating root cause.

anya_infra: Routing rule applied: eu-west1 embeddings -> warm pool-az1. KV cache writes disabled on pool-az3-nvme-04/05. Watching metrics.

infra_bot: Action: route-update executed by jason_oncall at 1795552560. KV cache toggle executed at 1795552582.

leo_sre: After mitigations p95 dropped from ~700ms -> ~150ms in 10m window. p99 still slightly elevated ~420ms.

ella_support: Customer contacted. They're ok with 60m mitigation window.

maria_dev: Next steps: 1) bisect kernel-driver combo on an isolated host, 2) check thin-provisioning reclamation schedules and storage controller firmware, 3) consider IO qdisc tuning (fq_codel -> noop) + nvme requeue settings.

jason_oncall: Assigning to @anya_infra and @leo_sre for bisect. I'll keep routing in place until we confirm stable.

anya_infra: Starting kernel bisect now. Will report back with repro kernel revision and fio profile.

leo_sre: Note for runbook: add a preflight check for NVMe queue depth after kernel/driver pushes.

ella_support: Thanks team. I'll keep ticket 8764 updated. :thumbsup:
